title: Tool Results That Fit the Context

questions.question: Why does a large tool result cost more than its own tokens?
options: It stays in the history and is re-sent on every later step
questions.explanation: Phase 3 · Lesson 11: history is re-sent every step.

questions.question: Why should a paged result include a total?
options: So the model doesn't count the visible rows when asked 'how many'
questions.explanation: The table shape answered '10 teapots' because it saw 10 rows.

questions.question: Which shape answered all 4 questions correctly?
options: top: the count and the first row after filtering and sorting
questions.explanation: 4/4 at about 151 tokens, against 1/4 at about 9,200 for raw.

questions.question: Why push filtering, sorting and counting into the tool?
options: To save the model work it often gets wrong, and to cut tokens
questions.explanation: Code does it exactly; the model misread even short sorted tables.

questions.question: Answers reported rupee prices in dollars. Why?
options: Field selection dropped 'currency', so the model made one up
questions.explanation: Keep units when you project fields.

questions.question: The unsorted page 'passed' the most-expensive-pan question. What should you check?
options: Nothing; a pass is a pass
Why it passed: the right row happened to be on the first page
